jobs.title: Customer Sales Associate, SM Dasmariñas
jobs.description: We are looking for a Customer Sales Associate to provide attentive, knowledgeable, and personalized customer service. This position will be reporting to work at SM Dasmariñas. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Customer Engagement and Service Delivery Welcome and acknowledge customers in a warm, respectful, and professional manner. Observe customer behaviour and offer assistance at an appropriate time without creating unnecessary pressure Understand customer needs through relevant questions and active listening. Assist customers in identifying suitable products based on preferences, occasion, size, and availability. Maintain a helpful and respectful approach throughout the customer journey. Handle routine customer inquiries and refer concerns requiring authorization to the Store Head. Product Knowledge and Merchandise Assistance Maintain working knowledge of current collections, product categories, sizes, styles, features, and available merchandise. Explain product information accurately and avoid unsupported claims. Recommend appropriate complementary products when relevant to customer needs. Assist with product selection, fitting-room requirements, alternative sizes, and styling options. Maintain appropriate customer privacy, comfort, and professional boundaries. Sales Productivity Contribute to the achievements of store sales targets through effective customer assistance. Apply customer engagement techniques that support conversion, ATV, UPT, and other approved KPIs. Participate in daily sales briefings and understand assigned productivity objectives. Respond constructively to coaching and implement agreed improvements. Balance sales productivity with the brand’s non-hard-selling service philosophy. jobs.title: Art Director
jobs.description: We’re looking for an Art Director with a sharp visual eye and strong production design experience to lead the look and feel of our campaigns. This is an onsite position at Armal Compound 2, M. Eusebio Avenue, San Miguel, Pasig City. You will report directly to the President. Summary This role is hands-on and concept-driven, focused on translating creative ideas into compelling visuals across campaign shoots and content. You’ll be responsible for shaping visual direction from concept through execution, ensuring every asset aligns with the brand and campaign strategy. Key Responsibilities Own the visual direction of campaigns across photo, video, digital and social media content. Lead production design for campaign shoots, including sets, props, styling, environments, and overall visual world. Develop and refine mood boards, visual references, and style frames to communicate creative vision. Collaborate closely with Creative Director, Brand and other departments to bring campaign concepts to life. Art direct photoshoots and video shoots on set, ensuring visual consistency and high-quality execution. Review and provide feedback on photography, video edits, motion, and retouching to ensure visuals meet creative standards. Ensure all campaign visuals align with brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries when appropriate. Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and visual excellence. Partner with external vendors, photographers, stylists, set designers, and production teams as needed.

jobs.title: Tax Associate
jobs.description: The Tax Associate supports the company’s tax compliance and reporting requirements by ensuring accurate and timely preparation, filing, and payment of taxes. Key Responsibilities: Prepare and file tax returns and required regulatory reports. Assist in computing VAT, withholding taxes, income tax, and other applicable taxes. Maintain complete and organized tax records and supporting documents. Assist in tax audits, reconciliations, and compliance requirements. Monitor tax deadlines and coordinate with Finance and Accounting on tax-related matters.

jobs.title: Cashier
jobs.description: We are looking for a Cashier to serve as an important control point in the completion of each customer purchase. This position will be reporting to work onsite. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Transaction Processing and Accuracy Process customer purchases accurately using POS system. Verify merchandise description, quantity, price, discounts, and transaction totals. Confirm that scanned merchandise corresponds to the actual items purchased. Apply only approved promotions, discounts, and transaction adjustments. Issue the required invoice or other approved transaction documents in accordance with company procedures and regulations. Immediately report pricing discrepancies, POS errors, and transaction irregularities. Payment Handling and Security Accept and process only company-approved payment methods. Follow prescribed procedures for cash, card, electronic wallet, and other authorized payment transactions. Verify payment completion before releasing merchandise. Safeguard cash, payment records, and assigned cashiering equipment. Prevent unauthorized access to POS accounts, cash drawers, and transaction records. Report suspected fraudulent transactions or payment irregularities. Customer Checkout Experience Greet and acknowledge customers courteously at the checkout counter. Process transactions with accuracy and reasonable efficiency. Explain payment, exchange, and other relevant policies clearly and respectfully. Address routine checkout inquiries and refer disputed matters to the Store Head. Thank customers sincerely and conclude transactions with the brand's customer service standards. Merchandise Verification and Packing Verify that all merchandise presented for payment has been correctly recorded in the transaction. Check merchandise condition and confirm that the correct items and quantities are released. Remove security tags or other applicable security devices following approved procedures. jobs.title: Set Up Manager for Luzon and VisMin
jobs.description: Openings: 1 for Luzon; 1 for Visayas and Mindanao (VisMin) Department: Production & Fabrication Reports to: Fabrication Lead Work arrangement: Field-based, with frequent travel and overnight or early-morning work during event ingress Role purpose The Setup Manager leads the on-site build and ingress of events in their assigned region. They coordinate crews, suppliers, equipment, and schedules so that the venue is set up safely, correctly, and on time, and is ready for client inspection and event operations. Key responsibilities Lead on-site ingress, setup, strike, and turnover for assigned events. Turn approved plans, drawings, and schedules into a practical setup sequence, including crew assignments and equipment needs. Coordinate with production, project or account teams, suppliers, venue personnel, and other contractors. Brief and supervise setup crews; monitor attendance, work quality, conduct, and progress. Check that staging, structures, signage, furniture, technical equipment, and other event elements match approved specifications. Monitor timelines and resolve on-site issues, escalating scope, cost, safety, or schedule concerns promptly. Enforce venue rules and company safety procedures; report hazards, incidents, and damage. Keep clear records of setup progress, labor and equipment use, issues, and client or venue approvals. Ensure the site is clean, organized, and ready for handover; oversee strike and the return of equipment after the event. Build and maintain working relationships with reliable local crews and suppliers in the assigned region. Travel within the assigned region and support events in other regions when required.
